blind.B1: Yes as an in-vitro exercise model: C2C12 ChR2(H134R) myotube monolayers with daily optogenetic stimulation (S2.2.p2, S5.2.p1). Exercise factor = stimulation at 1/4/10 Hz vs unstimulated control in the 60-min experiment; all 24 sequenced samples carry it. Controls twitch spontaneously (S3.1.p2). In-vitro cell-line design, policy question open.
blind.B2: 60-min experiment: control, 1 Hz, 4 Hz, 10 Hz, n=6 wells each = 24 (FIG2 caption, S2.2.p2); each condition vs control (FIG2 d).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: each well is an independent culture, one RNA sample per well (S5.4.p1, FIG2). Title-suffix key (1-6) in packet A links one sample per group but is only a well/replicate label; expression check not_supported (permutation p 0.034 / 0.80), no paper statement of pairing.
blind.B4: Paper does not state joint vs pairwise fit. S5.6.p4 only says DESeq2 with apeglm; FIG2 d says 'comparing averaged experimental conditions with averaged control conditions' (each condition vs control).
blind.B5: FIG2 d caption: significantly up/down genes 'log2(fold change) >0.5, padj <0.05'; S2.3.p1 same; BH-adjusted p (S5.6.p4); GSEA FDR q<0.25. Counts only as bars in Fig 2d, none in text.

checks.evidence: Analyzed as in-vitro optogenetic exercise model with caveat that controls twitch spontaneously (study caveats); matches B1.
grp CTRL/F1/F4/F10 n=6 each matches S2.2.p2; control is the paper's unstimulated control; no exclusions; titles carry the labels.
Contrasts coded treatment=F1/F4/F10, control=CTRL (design contrasts grp_Fx_vs_CTRL).
No repeated measures (B3); independent wells; no blocking needed.
One ~grp model on 24 samples with apeglm; paper silent (B4); pydeseq2 joint sensitivity also run. Joint vs pairwise not separately reported (open policy).
No batch/plate/sex recorded; duration aliased with experiment and explicitly not compared (harvest day 14 vs 16, media volume).
Salmon estimated counts (91% integer) rounded, documented; TPM rejected; DESeq2 route matches paper.
padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.5 on apeglm-shrunken LFC, non-inclusive, matches FIG2 d; audit padj-only rule recorded.
Paper counts only in bars, so no numeric match claimed; contradictions with text (e.g. Myog, ROS, Myh2 ranking, OXPHOS) are recorded as caveats rather than claimed agreement.
No stop or refusal; ChR2 transgene result not run for a stated true reason (matrix lacks the custom reference).

human_items: Policy (open): whether this in-vitro C2C12 optogenetic stimulation series counts as an exercise study.
Policy (open): joint ~grp model versus pairwise fits when the paper is silent; paper has no numeric DEG counts to discriminate.
summary: GSE306857（60 分钟实验）的分组、对照方向、阈值（padj<0.05 且 |log2FC|>0.5，apeglm 收缩）和 DESeq2 方法均与论文一致，未发现需要修改的项目。孔之间相互独立，无配对问题。仅有两个开放政策问题（体外细胞系是否算运动研究；论文未说明联合或两两拟合）留给人工判断。
